## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD5: When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic, covering: correction success; count drift; frozen-field mutation; exhausted retries; max_attempts=0 short-circuit; synthetic-exemption recognition via re-validation; correction returns malformed/schema-invalid JSON (consumes a retry, no recursion)

## TDD Requirement
This IS the RED test task. Write a new test file asserting expected behavior for dispatch_schema_correction() BEFORE the function exists. All tests must fail (RED) when first run.

Test file: tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_dispatch_schema_correction.py

Test approach:
- Given: mock dispatch_review returning a schema-valid/invalid response; mock validate-review-output.sh exit code; max_attempts=N
- When: dispatch_schema_correction() is called with diff_text, provider_chain, max_attempts, frozen_findings, and agent_id
- Then: assert the returned findings list, retry count, and synthetic error entry match expected behavior

Required test scenarios (one function per scenario):
1. test_correction_success: dispatch_review called once, returns schema-valid JSON with same count and frozen fields intact → returns corrected findings unchanged
2. test_correction_count_drift: dispatch_review returns schema-valid JSON but finding count changed → treat as failed attempt, route to synthetic error after exhaustion
3. test_correction_frozen_field_mutation: dispatch_review returns valid JSON with same count but one frozen field (e.g. severity) has different byte value → treat as failed, route to synthetic error
4. test_correction_exhausted_retries: dispatch_review always returns schema-invalid JSON, max_attempts=2 → appends synthetic schema_error finding (type=parse_error, severity=critical) after 2 attempts
5. test_correction_max_attempts_zero: max_attempts=0 → no dispatch_review call made, synthetic schema_error appended immediately
6. test_correction_malformed_response: dispatch_review returns non-JSON / parse error → counts as one failed attempt, no recursion (verified by asserting dispatch_review called exactly once per attempt)
7. test_correction_synthetic_exempt_revalidation: synthetic schema_error finding passes re-validation (type=parse_error is exempt from cited_excerpt/reachability) — verify by running validate-review-output.sh on output containing only the synthetic finding

## Test filename fuzzy-match note
Source: dispatch.py → normalized: dispatchpy
Test: test_dispatch_schema_correction.py → normalized: testdispatchschemacorrectionpy
'dispatchpy' is NOT a substring of 'testdispatchschemacorrectionpy' — .test-index entry required.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && python -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_dispatch_schema_correction.py --tb=short 2>&1 | grep -E "^FAILED|ImportError" || true; python -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_dispatch_schema_correction.py --collect-only -q 2>&1 | grep "test session starts"
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && ruff check tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_dispatch_schema_correction.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && ruff format --check tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_dispatch_schema_correction.py
- [ ] Test file contains all 7 required test functions
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && grep -c "^def test_" tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_dispatch_schema_correction.py | awk '{exit ($1 < 7)}'
- [ ] All 7 tests FAIL (RED) when run against codebase before dispatch_schema_correction() is implemented
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && python -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_dispatch_schema_correction.py 2>&1 | grep -E "^FAILED|ImportError|AttributeError" | wc -l | awk '{exit ($1 < 1)}'
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker [test_correction_success] for plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/dispatch.py
  Verify: grep '\[test_correction_success\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
- [ ] .test-index entry added mapping plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/dispatch.py to tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_dispatch_schema_correction.py
  Verify: grep -q 'dso_ci_review/dispatch.py' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index && grep -q 'test_dispatch_schema_correction.py' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
